## Description

A script in infra/ that sets the Entra External ID company branding (logo, background, colours, sign-in page text, privacy and terms links) per country from files in the repo, so the hosted email-code, MFA and recovery pages look like the 6 Nov design as far as Entra allows. An administrator runs it against the dev and later production tenants; the run is recorded in docs/05-delivery/session-handoff.md.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the script runs against a tenant, when a user signs in, then the hosted pages show the Medvya logo, colours and privacy and terms links for that country.
- [ ] **AC2.** The script holds no secret and reads the tenant from arguments; it is idempotent.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
